Poetic Treasures. Only Nihira's own published poetry or her recitations. Fields per poem: id (unique), title, lang ('mr' Marathi, 'hi' Hindi, 'en' English), author, date (optional YYYY-MM-DD), text (use 
 for a new line, blank line 

 between stanzas), videoId (optional recitation video), source. Never paste song lyrics or other people's copyrighted poems.
subtitle: Poetic Treasures: A Journey Through My Favorite Verses
intro: Poetry is something very close to Nihira's heart. Watch out for the series "Poetic Treasures" on Youtube, where Nihira will recite a few of her favorite poems in her soulful voice.
